question: Who has been appointed to head Tata Consultancy Services' (TCS) new Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Services Transformation Unit? (August 2025)
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amit Kapur.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Amit Kapur, a TCS veteran, has been appointed to head the newly created Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Services Transformation Unit at TCS.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Tata Consultancy Services (TCS)** has launched a dedicated **Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Services Transformation Unit**, marking a significant move for India's IT sector.

 
 
• 
 
**Amit Kapur**, with over 20 years at TCS, has been appointed as the head of the unit, set to focus on **AI-driven solutions**, **innovation**, and **efficiency**.

 
 
• 
 
The new unit aims to **consolidate AI capabilities**, **drive domain solutions**, and foster **AI partnerships** for global clients.

 
 
• 
 
**TCS’s strategic move** differentiates it from competitors, setting the stage for **AI-led growth** amid global economic uncertainty.
